description: US federal grant opportunities from Grants.gov (search2 API): opportunity number, title, funding agency, open and close dates, status and CFDA numbers, for a keyword. Opportunity listings only, not award decisions. Related tools on this server, for a different need: gov_sam_gov_wage_determinations when you need US federal prevailing wage determinations from SAM.gov; gov_sbir_government_grants when you need US SBIR/STTR small-business R&D awards from SBIR.gov. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.
name: gov_grants_gov
